description: Which Workbench capture holds which Microsoft Graph v1.0 resource, and which resources are not business data, for ontology/generator/graph.py. A rule names resource types (CSDL entity types) and, optionally, a type the request path went through first (via; the nearest one wins over a rule without via); a bound rule whose relation no capture reads carries blocked (the exact reason and its decision record). Every action and $ref is a write operation, and so is a template every upstream request of which writes (write_method: its registry methods hold no GET and no unknown request); a template bound to a family is read only when some upstream request GETs it. templates: a registry template that does not resolve as folded, read at one of its upstream citations (evidence): as (the template with its folded values written out, every literal segment kept; a value holds no '/' unless it is a drive path it opens as path addressing, root:/a/b, closed by the template's next ':') or a not_business_data reason with its decision. generate: the generated types of a family, one per relation, each property typed by the CSDL property its captured row field holds (fields: row path -> CSDL property path).

rules.note: integrations/capture_mail.py: message versions (a $value read is the same message's MIME).
integrations/capture_sharepoint.py reads drives by id: SharePoint libraries and OneDrive for Business drives (also a SharePoint library); content is the captured file bytes.
A drive item's own list item: its column snapshot is captured with every file version (capture_sharepoint listItem fields).
Workbook cells are the content of the captured file.

Items of a SharePoint list that is not a document library: integrations/capture_sharepoint_lists.py captures the lists its scope names (integrations/sharepoint_list_capture_scope.json; devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-10-gen-graph-residual-list-items.md option b), item permissions as their audience.

integrations/capture_teams.py: the chats of every account on the mail allowlist (operating/case_mail_scope.json; devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-ovs-teams-capture.md item 2), projected gated by chat membership (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-10-followup-decisions.md item 6).
integrations/capture_teams.py: a chat's own record (topic, type, times, participants), gated by its membership like its messages (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-27-teams-conversation-objects.md).

integrations/capture_teams.py: a channel's own record (name, membership type, times, participants), gated by its membership like its messages (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-27-teams-conversation-objects.md).
integrations/capture_teams.py: a team (name, creation), read with its standard channels' records (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-27-teams-conversation-objects.md).
A container, its configuration or its schema: the captures traverse it to reach the items; it holds no business record of its own.
Directory identities and memberships: permission inputs (integrations/graph_directory.py), never ontology records.
Change-notification subscriptions of the upstream sync engines.
Rendering and formatting of a file, not its content.
Calendars and meeting transcripts of the agent tooling (agentic-swarm); default until decided, reversal: a capture and a family.
To Do and Planner tasks the agent tooling writes; Mission Control is the task system of record.

/drives/{}/{}/{}.note: drives/<id>/root:<parent_path>/<name>: the folded values are path addressing under the drive root (a folder by path).

graph_teams.description: Generated by ontology/generator/graph.py from the pinned Graph v1.0 CSDL subset (chatMessage) and the Teams capture's row fields. Do not edit.

wb.mentions.note: Identifier mentions extracted by the one identifier grammar from a Teams message's subject and body (ontology/project_graph.py TeamsCaptures.documents) and resolved through the identifier index; stored as lead links (store_mention_links).

ctx.mentions.note: Document mentions any object: mention resolution (lead/corroborated).

links.name: in_channel
links.description: The channel a captured channel message or reply was posted in (Graph structure: the message's team and channel ids; ontology/schema/domains/teams_conversations.json).

TeamsChannelMessage.description: One captured Teams channel message or reply version (Graph chatMessage; lineage mail until the Teams lineage decision, devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-ovs-teams-capture.md item 1). Readers are trimmed per channel and by the channel's captured membership. Source text is untrusted; the body is cited, not projected.

links.name: in_chat
links.description: The chat a captured chat message was posted in (Graph structure: the message's chat id; ontology/schema/domains/teams_conversations.json).

TeamsChatMessage.description: One captured Teams chat message version (Graph chatMessage; lineage mail, devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-ovs-teams-capture.md item 1). The chats of every account on the mail allowlist are captured (item 2); readers are trimmed per chat and by the chat's captured membership, and a chat without a captured membership is not projected (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-10-followup-decisions.md item 6). Source text is untrusted; the body is cited, not projected.

graph_sharepoint_lists.description: Generated by ontology/generator/graph.py from the pinned Graph v1.0 CSDL subset (listItem). Row fields are the Graph listItem JSON (fields expanded). Do not edit.

SharePointListItem.description: One item of a SharePoint list that is not a document library (Graph listItem, its column values in fields: only the columns the capture scope names, numbers as exact decimal text), captured by integrations/capture_sharepoint_lists.py for the lists its scope names. Readers are trimmed per list and by the item permissions captured with each version.
